clauses: After `Running` with peers and a blocked exit node, `NoState` shows no visible `ts-self-ip4` or `ts-blocked-alert`, and `ts-state` reads "no daemon"
With `ts-devices-row` clicked open and peers seeded, `NoState` shows no visible `ts-peer` and no visible `ts-devices-card`
With the exit sub-card open, `NoState` shows no visible `ts-exit-card`; with the settings sub-card open, no visible `ts-settings-card`
With one health entry, `NoState` shows no visible `ts-issue` and no visible `ts-issue-count`
Each other state gives its phrase, and a blocked exit node in `Running` reads "exit node unreachable"
Setup: each hidden part is checked visible in `Running` first
